name: stack
description: Stacked pull request workflows over the github/gh-stack CLI extension, as three steps: split a working tree into an ordered chain of branches (stack:commit), push them and open one PR per layer (stack:submit), and rebase the stack as trunk moves or to change a lower layer (stack:sync). Every command runs non-interactively, and each layer becomes one reviewable pull request based on the layer below it.
